name: vmodal-track
description: Track a subject through VModal video collections: find every verified appearance of it and return a trail (where, when, for how long, in what order). Works for a description ("red taxis in Kyoto") or for one specific subject ("this taxi", "the same woman", "the one at 1:57"). Use when the user asks to track, follow, trace, or find everywhere / every time something appears, e.g. "Track red cars. Collection: city". For a single good match use vmodal-find instead. Requires the vmodal MCP (dev branch) and the vmodal-find skill.
